2607.17620.title: PoLoRA: A Preconditioned Orthogonalized LoRA Optimizer
2607.17620.paper_summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) makes finetuning large language models cheaper by adding to each weight matrix a trainable low-rank update parameterized as the product of two matrices. These matrices are usually trained with Adam, which treats them as a single flat vector of parameters and ignores both the matrix and product structure of LoRA. Applying a matrix-aware optimizer such as Muon to each factor does not consistently improve over Adam, and neither do the product-aware Muon variants proposed in concurrent works. To realize consistent gains, we introduce PoLoRA, a Preconditioned Orthogonalized LoRA optimizer built from three ingredients: a product-aware spectral update direction, curvature preconditioning derived from controlling the per-sample loss change, and a magnitude rule that controls the sizes of both the factor and merged updates. We evaluate PoLoRA on instruction-tuning datasets for code and math across models from 1B to 8B parameters, and find that it reaches the final held-out loss achieved by tuned Adam in 1.2-1.7 times fewer steps, while adding at most 3% per-step overhead. Compared to Adam, PoLoRA is also less sensitive to the learning rate, and its optimal learning rate is stable across ranks.
2607.17620.paper_summary_zh: 低秩適應（LoRA）透過在每個權重矩陣中添加可訓練的低秩更新來降低大型語言模型的微調成本，該更新參數化為兩個矩陣的乘積。這些矩陣通常使用 Adam 進行訓練，Adam 將它們視為單一的平坦參數向量，並忽略了 LoRA 的矩陣和乘積結構。對每個因子應用像 Muon 這樣的矩陣感知優化器並不總是比 Adam 有所改進，而在同時進行的工作中提出的產品感知 Muon 變體也沒有改善。為了實現穩定的增益，我們引入了 PoLoRA，一種基於三個成分構建的預條件正交化 LoRA 優化器：一個產品感知的光譜更新方向、基於控制每個樣本損失變化的曲率預條件，以及一個控制因子和合併更新大小的幅度規則。我們在從 1B 到 8B 參數的模型上評估了 PoLoRA 在代碼和數學的指令微調數據集上，發現它在 1.2-1.7 倍更少的步驟中達到了經過調整的 Adam 所實現的最終保留損失，同時每步最多增加 3% 的開銷。與 Adam 相比，PoLoRA 對學習率的敏感度也較低，其最佳學習率在不同秩之間保持穩定。
